full_prompt_en: A wide hand drawn satirical illustration shows an immense crowd pressed together along a worn city street, watching a solitary man kneel on the roadway before a tiny boxlike motor vehicle. At the far left, spectators fill the frame from a low brick barrier up to the top edge, their heads stacked in dense irregular rows. The people closest to the viewer have long faces, round glasses, heavy brows, patterned jackets, and surprised or weary expressions. A woman in a bright rust red coat and another in muted yellow bring small color accents to the otherwise gray blue crowd. Behind them dozens of faces become progressively smaller and more loosely drawn, creating a mass of curious onlookers. Across the street on the right, another line of figures stands against weathered stone buildings. In the near middle, a stout man in a blue coat and matching brimmed hat crouches with his back partly toward the viewer, holding a tiny object in both hands. A little bird stands on the pavement beside him. Ahead, the small antique vehicle has a yellow lamp and thin dark wheels, with its angular gray body lit softly from the left. Tramlike tracks cut diagonally through cracked road dust toward the machine. Fine ink outlines and colored pencil or watercolor shading describe every coat, stone seam, and face without making the picture polished. Daylight is flat and cool, with gentle shadows below feet and along the rough street. The improbable scale contrast between huge audience and little machine gives the scene its dry, comic tension.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅宽幅手绘讽刺插画描绘庞大人群挤在磨旧的城市街道两侧，观看一名独自跪在路面上的男子面对一辆小小的盒状机动车。最左侧，围观者从低矮砖墙后一直堆到画面顶缘，头颅排列成密集而不规则的行列。离观者最近的人有长脸、圆眼镜、浓眉、花纹夹克，以及惊讶或疲惫的神情。一位穿亮赭红外套的女子和另一位穿低饱和黄色衣服的人，为灰蓝色人群带来少量色彩重音。后方几十张面孔逐渐变小、线条更松，形成一大群好奇观众。街对面右侧，另一排人站在风化石楼前。近处中间，一名穿蓝色外套和同色帽子的壮实男子蹲着，背部部分朝向观者，双手捧着一个小东西。一只小鸟立在他旁边的路面上。前方的小型古董车辆有一盏黄色灯和细瘦深色车轮，棱角分明的灰色车身从左边得到柔和光照。类似电车轨道的线斜穿过有裂纹和尘土的路面，通向机器。细密墨线和色铅笔或水彩般的阴影描述每件外套、每道石缝和每张脸，却不把画面磨得光滑。日光平坦偏冷，脚下和粗糙街面只有轻柔阴影。巨大观众与小小机器之间荒诞的比例反差，赋予场景冷幽默张力。
style_prompt_en: Hand drawn satirical illustration combines lively fine ink contours with muted washes and dry colored pencil texture. Many individually varied small shapes crowd together in irregular rows, while an open stretch of pale ground creates a strong pause in the composition. Proportions are gently exaggerated: long narrow forms, rounded blunt forms, and expressive asymmetry coexist within a believable setting. Lines remain slightly wobbly and exploratory, with crosshatching and short scratches gathering in shadow and around worn edges. The palette is cool gray blue, faded ocher, dusty rust, and warm stone, with a few brighter accents distributed sparingly. Background forms recede through smaller scale, lighter value, and looser detail rather than blur. Broad overcast light keeps the scene evenly legible and gives surfaces only modest cast shadows. Dense observation and comic timing balance one another, so the image feels busy yet clear, tactile, and quietly absurd.
style_prompt_zh: 手绘讽刺插画把活跃的细墨轮廓与低饱和洗色、干性色铅笔肌理结合。许多各不相同的小形体挤成不规则行列，大片浅色空地在构图中形成强烈停顿。比例受到温和夸张：细长形、圆钝形和富于表情的不对称并存于可信环境。线条略微摇摆、带探索痕迹，排线与短刮痕聚在阴影和磨损边缘。色域包括冷灰蓝、褪色赭黄、尘土般的锈红与暖石色，少量更亮的重音分散出现。背景通过缩小尺度、变浅明度与放松细节后退，而非依赖模糊。宽广阴天光使全景均匀可辨，表面只有适度投影。密集观察与喜剧节奏相互平衡，使图像繁忙却清楚、可触并带安静荒诞感。
theme_en: Crowd watching a man kneel before a tiny road vehicle
theme_zh: 人群围观一名男子跪在小型道路车辆前
name: Jon Kudelka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
